scope: Read-only comparison of installed r2/r3 package manifests and reuse of existing AL-T00 stage evidence; no probes, production requests, retries, or server mutations performed.

manifest_comparison.method: Read-only read of each installed root manifest; compared SHA-256 entries by exact relative path.
manifest_comparison.scope_limit: These are installed package manifest entries. External systemd unit files are not asserted by this hash map; their equivalence is based on the root's stated unchanged deployment configuration.

r3_delta_basis: Root states r3 differs from r2 only in the allowlisted BFF acceptance logger, its tests, and documentation. The exact r3 CI and r3 browser/API/DB/log correlation proof cover the added logger behavior.
metadata_correction: The r3 package SHA256 was corrected from the primary r3 receipt; no assessment findings or verdicts changed.

case_reuse.r2_fact: Two concurrent same-UUID POSTs returned 200/202; conflicting kind returned 422; one persisted effect.
case_reuse.why_transfer_is_valid: Platform views, models, migrations, worker, API contract, BFF CLI/launch/release files and locks have identical installed hashes. The r3-only BFF logger adds an allowlisted success event and is independently exercised on r3; it does not change the idempotency transaction or conflict policy.

case_reuse.r2_fact: Accepted a fresh job while the stage worker was stopped, restarted platform API and worker, then observed the same job processed once; readiness was 200 on all four HTTP components.
case_reuse.why_transfer_is_valid: Worker, platform API, model, migration, launch/release CLI hashes match across installed r2/r3 manifests; the BFF success logger does not touch the pending-job or worker-restart path. Root reports stage units unchanged.

case_reuse.r2_fact: With only the stage platform runtime role set NOLOGIN, liveness remained 200, readiness and writes returned 503, no row was created; LOGIN restoration recovered the same UUID once.
case_reuse.why_transfer_is_valid: Platform settings/views, worker, DB contract and launch configuration have identical r2/r3 hashes; no r3 migration was pending or applied. R3 logger delta is after successful BFF acceptance and does not change database readiness behavior.

case_reuse.r2_fact: Both runtime roles were non-superuser; platform DDL and cross-database connects were denied.
case_reuse.why_transfer_is_valid: The stage database contracts, migrations, runtime code, and application roles/configuration are unchanged; those stage least-privilege results remain valid for r3.
case_reuse.unclosed_product_invariant: The plan's explicit stage-credentials-against-production rejection was not exercised. Production credentials/DB were intentionally not queried or created, so that denial remains unverified (environment boundary, not a demonstrated product defect).

case_reuse.r2_fact: Arbitrary/forged session and tenant cookies produced 404 for /app, /staff, and forged tenant route.
case_reuse.why_transfer_is_valid: Root's r2→r3 diff scope confines runtime code change to the engineering BFF logger; those default-deny routes and their auth/tenant handling are outside the changed path. R3 browser and logger checks qualify the changed BFF path separately.

case_reuse.r2_fact: The stage-UID-only temporary nft test denied the legacy loopback 8765 port; the deny counter stayed unchanged during a successful browser roundtrip, while only the expected own-upstream/reply counters advanced. The table was removed.
case_reuse.evidence_provenance: This egress run is recorded in the root's stage-author evidence and is not an independently repeated firewall mutation by this reviewer.
case_reuse.why_transfer_is_valid: UID/unit policy is reported unchanged. The r3 delta emits only an allowlisted stdout event and adds no network client or destination; exact r3 CI and the r3 end-to-end event chain exercised it.
case_reuse.unclosed_product_invariant: The observed old-loopback block and roundtrip were verified; this is not a general packet capture of all possible future traffic. No product defect was demonstrated.

evidence: Root's r1→r2→r1 real stage cycle read the same probe back processed once with the database intact.
Independent r3→r2→r3 cycle read the same probe/correlation back with effect_count=1 and all four services ready on each side; no database restore was used.
AL_T00_11.interpretation: Together these establish data-preserving backward/forward compatibility for the tested r1/r2 and r2/r3 pairs; no claim is made for arbitrary future releases.

remaining_acceptance_limits: AL-T00-08 production credential denial remains unverified because no production DB or credential request was in scope.
AL-T00-15 evidence is the author's stage-only nft run; it demonstrates the recorded deny paths and roundtrip, not universal future network behavior.
Case reuse is component-equivalence evidence, not a claim that the exact r3 release independently repeated each r2 stage action.
overall: No product defect identified in the reviewed cases; reusing r2 stage evidence for unchanged components is justified with the listed scope limits. This assessment does not change the original r3 receipt or override external ACME/documentation-CI gates.
